WHERE s.name = 'embed_category'` query returns at least one row. On fresh installs / when the `embed_category` setting row is absent or doesn’t match any category, the result set will be empty, so `[0]` will be `nil` (or out-of-range) and `['id']` will raise before the later `if category_id == 0` fallback can run.
